## Sign-off

By submitting this PR, you certify your contribution under the
[Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/) — see
CONTRIBUTING.md. Every commit needs a `Signed-off-by:` trailer
(`git commit -s`); the DCO check on this PR will tell you if one is missing.

---

Note: CI on this repo runs a light lint + headless-unit suite. The full
hardware suite (real Docker, real Caddy, GPU-gated tests) runs privately
on import — a green check here isn't the full story, and a maintainer may
come back with hardware-suite failures to fix before merge.
